# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

cand_0003 — FINAL iteration (3/3), after two consecutive rejects (cand_0001 +0.100, cand_0002 +0.117), each of which the gate recorded as "no damage, needs POWER or SIZE, not a redesign." So this round does NOT redesign: it keeps every proven-safe edit from cand_0002 and adds the one NEW deterministic WRITE guard neither prior candidate had — a payment-method-count guard on `book_reservation` — to raise per-task effect size on the hardest cluster.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | A — Wrong-reservation targeting | 17, 22, 8 | User names a trip by route/date, no id; agent anchors on the FIRST id from `get_user_details` (opaque ids) and writes to the wrong reservation; every downstream write diverges | CAPABILITY-GAP | enrich always-called read (`reservations_detail`) + policy identify-by-route (kept from cand_0002) |
| 2 | B — Booking payment: stale price + cert-split | 25, 23 | Agent prices from the OLD reservation's stored fare (299 vs live 375) → `book_reservation` rejects "does not add up"; and crams 3 certificates into one reservation (gold needs one reservation per passenger) | CAPABILITY-GAP + BEHAVIORAL | NEW payment-method-count in-body guard (**new this round**) + `get_price_quote` + enriched error + split prose |
| 3 | E — Narrate/transfer-without-action | 12, 37, 25, 23 | After "yes" (or an out-of-scope detour) the agent reports done / transfers / is cut off before issuing the write | BEHAVIORAL | policy execute-after-confirm + recover-from-error + finish-before-transfer (prose; no code lever exists — the stall is ending the turn) |
| 4 | C — Hand-computed charge/refund | 11 | DB write correct but agent states a hand-computed refund (5548) dropping the ×passengers multiplier; gold COMMUNICATE = 5244 (engine's exact delta, discarded) | KNOWLEDGE | update tools return `payment_delta`/`amount_charged`/`amount_refunded` + policy quote-the-returned-amount |
| 5 | D — Unauthorized cancel of a flown reservation | 37 | Agent cancels NQNU5R whose segments (05-13/14) are before current date 05-15; policy forbids, API does NOT enforce | BEHAVIORAL | `cancel_reservation` already-flown/already-cancelled in-body guard (kept from cand_0002) |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| D | code guard (DETERMINISTIC) | tools.py `cancel_reservation` | refuse cancel if any segment flown (date < 2024-05-15 or status flying/landed) or already cancelled; enforces policy the API skips. Class rule, no task literal | yes — verified silent on 19 (05-28) & 23 (05-26/28) |
| B | **code guard (DETERMINISTIC, NEW this round)** | tools.py `book_reservation` | count payment sources; limit {certificate:1, credit_card:1, gift_card:3} and raise an actionable split instruction BEFORE the "does not add up" check. Enforces policy line 86 the engine ignores. **The POWER lever neither prior candidate had** | yes — verified allows every gold split, task 25 (1 gift+1 cc), task 8 (1 cert) |
| B/E | code (enriched error) | tools.py `book_reservation` | "does not add up" names authoritative total + flights/baggage/insurance breakdown + signed shortfall + "re-call summing to EXACTLY N, don't reuse stored prices"; not-found lists ids | yes — only error text; passing calls never reach it |
| B | NEW read tool | tools.py `get_price_quote` | authoritative total from CURRENT prices via the engine's exact formula; 15 tools total (<20) | yes — additive read tool |
| C | code (enriched return) | tools.py `update_reservation_flights` / `update_reservation_baggages` | return full `model_dump()` PLUS `payment_delta`/`amount_charged`/`amount_refunded`; DB mutates in place BEFORE return | yes — DB hash grader reads DB, not return |
| A | code (enriched return) | tools.py `get_user_details` | return old User dump PLUS `reservations_detail` (route/date/cabin/pax per reservation) on the ALWAYS-called first read | yes — superset of old dump; DB grader reads DB |
| A | policy (prose) | policy.md "Identify the CORRECT reservation" | match by route/city/date via `reservations_detail`; resolve referenced prior flight via `get_reservation_details`; city→airport; never default to first id; ask if ambiguous | yes — reinforces existing rule, no literal |
| E | policy (contract) | policy.md execute-after-confirm / recover-from-error / finish-before-transfer | WRONG/RIGHT worked examples for a mid-tier reader | yes — no passing task relied on narrating-without-acting |
| B | policy (prose) | policy.md authoritative pricing + one-cert→one-reservation-per-passenger split | pairs `get_price_quote` + count guard with the stated procedure | yes — no literal |
| C | policy (prose) | policy.md quote-returned-amount + change-only-requested-segments | points at `amount_refunded`/`amount_charged`; warns against dropped ×pax multiplier and swapping unrequested flights | yes — no literal |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change: the trace it targets → what the guard/computation now does on those exact inputs)
- cancel guard → replayed on 37 NQNU5R (seg 2024-05-13 < today 2024-05-15) ⇒ REFUSES with transfer instruction; on 19 Z7GOZK (05-28) & 23 K1NW8N (05-26/28) ⇒ ALLOWS (the passing cancels).
- payment-count guard → replayed on 23-t0 (3 certificates, one reservation) ⇒ REFUSES with "split into one reservation per passenger"; on every gold per-reservation split (1 cert + gifts/cc), task 25 (1 gift+1 cc), task 8 (1 cert) ⇒ ALLOWS.
- enriched "does not add up" → on a bad split prints total + breakdown + signed shortfall + resubmit instruction; passing bookings never enter the branch.
- get_price_quote → task-25 live economy legs 175+200 ⇒ total=375 (= gold total); formula = Σ price×pax + 50×bags + 30×pax insurance.
- update-tool returns → task 11 engine delta 456−5700 = −5244 ⇒ amount_refunded=5244 (= gold COMMUNICATE value); DB write identical to seed.
- get_user_details → `reservations_detail` built from each reservation's origin/destination + per-segment O→D + status; return is a strict superset.
- All of the above checked with a standalone replay (`/tmp/guard_test.py`) feeding the engine's exact arithmetic the traces' exact arguments; `ast.parse` OK on tools.py; `tools/__pycache__` cleared.

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees / parallel features used: parallel read-only diagnostic subagents (one per failure cluster) extracted the exact write-call arguments and gold DB/COMMUNICATE values from each failing & passing trial; guards were then replayed against those ground-truth arguments. (tau2 is not importable in the working dir, so I read the tau2 source helpers on disk and reproduced the engine arithmetic standalone rather than spending turns installing it.)
- Prior iterations I read from ./prior_iterations/ + ./RUNMAP.md: cand_0001 (empty-seed: 2 read tools incl. the skippable `find_reservations` + guards + contract; REJECTED +0.100, no damage) and cand_0002 (replaced `find_reservations` with the unskippable `get_user_details` enrichment; REJECTED +0.117, no damage). Lesson applied: both improved the mean and broke nothing but every task stayed `unresolved` (< 2·SE) — the gate explicitly says the lever is POWER/SIZE, not redesign. So I kept all of cand_0002's safe edits verbatim and added ONE new deterministic guard (payment-count) to make the hardest cluster's per-trial effect bigger and model-compliance-independent.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The two DETERMINISTIC in-body WRITE guards (cancel-flown, payment-count) — they fire every trial regardless of the mid-tier model's compliance, and both are verified silent on all passing trials. This is the gate's requested POWER lever; do not revert to prose-only.
- `get_user_details` → `reservations_detail` on the always-called read (unskippable), NOT a separate optional lookup tool (cand_0001's `find_reservations` was the weak version).
- update-tool amount returns + `get_price_quote`: cheap, safe, additive, and they fix a COMMUNICATE-only task (11) that DB guards cannot.
- Never re-introduce anything LEDGER marks as having broken a task (LEDGER shows no `broke` for either prior candidate — so nothing is forbidden on damage grounds; the constraint is purely to raise power without redesign).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Task 40 — documented tau2 user-simulator infra noise (###STOP### + leaked reasoning); instructed not to optimize against it.
- Task 23's EXACT per-reservation gift-card allocation (both gift cards on passenger 1, credit card on 2 & 3) — a task-specific split with no general rule the traces support; hardcoding it would overfit and the held-out gate would reject it. The count guard + split prose make the correct structure much more likely without a literal.
- A composite split-booking WRITE tool (issue N one-passenger bookings in one call) — considered as the strongest cluster-B lever but it still needs the model to supply the per-passenger payment split (judgment not removed), and removing the raw `book_reservation` primitive risks regressing single-reservation bookings (tasks 8, 25). The in-body count guard is strictly safe; the composite tool is the lever to try in a FUTURE run if cluster B persists.
- Forcing `get_reservation_details` before a "same-flight" booking in code — no write tool receives the referenced reservation id, so there is no code choke point; handled via the `reservations_detail` enrichment + prose.
